description: Look up a person by email address. Returns contact info, demographics, and optionally associated properties. Costs 1 people data credit per matched person (no charge if no match).

fields.description: DealMachine field IDs; people fields return on each person, while property fields return under property and may cost a property credit

include_properties.description: Include associated properties for each matched person. Costs 1 property data credit per property.

location.description: Optional match location by state, ZIP, county, or numeric city place ID

code.description: State abbreviation, ZIP code, county FIPS, or numeric city place ID

name: dealmachine_enrich_email
